name: rawread
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS and trackdisk.device for floppy reads
notes: Toni Wilen's 2 December 2001 m68k release matches the shipped executable by SHA-256. The binary has no $VER tag.
The Aminet readme is a sidecar download. BCWB installs only the command.
Directory Opus owns the configuration containing the standard and extended rawread actions. TSgui owns its embedded Rawread-derived code and guide. WHDLoad owns DIC and RawDIC.
